rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with strong force or energy.

example.english: The firefighters pulled the barrier open vigorously.
example.jyutping: siu1 fong4 jyun4 daai6 lik6 laai1 hoi1 dou6 zaap6

rows.note: Use this for putting sustained effort into work or an activity, rather than stressing physical force.

example.english: We studied vigorously this time and finally got good grades.
example.traditional: 我哋今次落力溫書，終於考到好成績。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 lok6 lik6 wan1 syu1 zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing4 zik1

rows.note: Use this especially when strongly supporting, opposing, defending, or urging something, often in more formal contexts.

example.english: The school vigorously urged parents not to let their children bring mobile phones to school.
example.traditional: 校方極力呼籲家長唔好畀子女帶手機返學。
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 gik6 lik6 fu1 jyu6 gaa1 zoeng2 m4 hou2 bei2 zi2 neoi5 daai3 sau2 gei1 faan1 hok6
